title: TTML/DFXP subtitles that are not UTF-8 cannot be converted to SRT
prompt:
Converting TTML (DFXP) subtitles to SRT fails when the subtitle document is not UTF-8. A document that starts with `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16"?>` and is encoded in UTF-16 cannot be converted, because the subtitle file is read as UTF-8 text before it is parsed; the XML declaration should decide the encoding.

`youtube_dl.utils.dfxp2srt` should take the raw bytes of the subtitle document (as read from the file in binary mode), for UTF-8 and non-UTF-8 documents alike, and return the SRT text; the subtitle conversion that calls it should pass it the file's bytes.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q test/<file>.py` runs one test file. test/test_download.py and the per-site tests need network access.
